description:
Retire the private file-backed setups of the `fast_rules` suite.

## Background

Shared test support constructs an initialised file-backed repository from caller-supplied configuration, an executor over a file-backed root, and a temporary declaration directory. The profiled setup in `cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs` is already gone.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/default_rules_registry_derivation_tests.rs`: `executor` (`:18`), `setup_initialized_repo` (`:28`).
- `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/effective_rules_tests.rs`: `repo` (`:16`), `executor` (`:36`).
- `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/type_hierarchy_schema_regen_tests.rs`: `executor` (`:10`), `setup_initialized_repo` (`:16`).
- `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/undeclared_taxonomy_tests.rs`: `scaffold_declaring` (`:20`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No file in `fast_rules` defines a function that creates a file-backed repository or opens a file-backed executor.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: fast_rules file-backed tests use the shared constructors
